correctness.rationale: Positive normalized Shepard weights sum to 1, so all data triples decompose into a constant and two unit steps; the operator BV seminorm equals the larger variation of the two step responses. The opposite-cell weight has one strict interior maximum, obtained by differentiating its denominator and solving ((a+b-x)/(x-a))^(p+1)=(a+b)/a. Evaluating the maximum and reflecting produces the stated r,c coefficient. Monotonicity in mesh ratio follows from positive derivative of s(1+c_s) and monotonic c_s^-p; limits p down to 0, p up to infinity, r down to 0 and pr→tau follow explicit power asymptotics, including tau=0. Independently evaluated several unequal meshes, p values and the nodal/extremum formula with numerical agreement; inspected checker.py; finite tests supplement the fully analytic claim.
residual_risks: Singular mesh-power double limit needs careful pr→0 bound; supplied p^(1/(p+1))(pr)^(p/(p+1)) control was checked and excludes unproven many-site behavior.
